rules.numeric_noise_floor: 1000 * machine_epsilon * max(1, max(abs(y))) for each trajectory
rules.extrema_method: sign changes in first differences after t=1 h; discard only excursions at or below numeric noise floor
rules.FIG8A_NOMINAL_DAMPED: PASS only if every evaluable successive complete oscillation amplitude is strictly smaller than its predecessor; otherwise FAIL or INDETERMINATE if too few cycles
rules.FIG8B_LIMIT_CYCLE: finite-window sustained compatibility PASS if at least two complete amplitudes survive and the full amplitude sequence is not strictly decreasing; stable limit cycle itself remains unproved at this gate
rules.FIG8C_RELAXATION_OSCILLATION: apply the same sustained-periodicity rule as B; relaxation-like/spiky morphology remains NOT_QUANTITATIVELY_ADJUDICATED because no paper-defined threshold exists

required_preservation: Any PASS, FAIL, INDETERMINATE, or refusal produced under these inherited rules is retained. The v0.1 mechanical failure remains independently preserved.
next_gate_if_compatible: freeze equilibrium/local-stability and representation-sensitivity analysis before Jacobian poles or any chi_bio construction
